approved: Family Assistance Legislation Amendment (Jobs for Families Child Care Package) Bill 2015

The Family Assistance Legislation Amendment (Jobs for Families Child Care Package) Bill 2015 was introduced to create a simpler, means-tested child care subsidy replacing the current child care benefit and rebate, with subsidy rates ranging from 85% for families earning $65,710 or less down to 20% for incomes above $340,000. The package also includes an additional child care subsidy for vulnerable families, a nanny pilot program, strengthened compliance measures, and over $3 billion in extra funding, aiming to support more than 1.2 million families and prioritise low- and middle-income earners.
